boundary.description: From the junction of Lancaster Road and Cholmondeley Road, E along Cholmondeley Road, Claremont Road, Eccles Old Road, Half Edge Lane, Victoria Crescent, Ellesmere Road to the end of the road. Then NW by a beeline to Folly Brook (including all Welbeck Road and Godolphin Close estate in the Ss Peter and Paul parish) and by a beeline across Eccles College to the S border of Swinton Park Golf Club. E along Sunningdale Drive (both sides in St Luke’s parish) and Lancaster Road to its junction with Cholmondeley Road.
